EntryWarningDocument.description:
One warning about a ticker that was added: it could not be confirmed, or SEC EDGAR's list does not include it.

It has the shape of a rule error: filling every placeholder of ``template`` with its ``arguments`` gives
``message``.

arguments.description: The values the message shows, by name.
arguments.title: Arguments

code.description: Why the ticker could not be confirmed, or that SEC EDGAR's list does not include it.

message.description: The warning for a person; it carries no guarantee.
message.title: Message

reason_code.description: The failure reason code that kept the ticker from being checked: a provider failure code or a database failure code. Null when the ticker was not recognized or is not in SEC EDGAR's ticker list.

template.description: The message with each value written as a placeholder named as in arguments, such as {ticker}; replacing every placeholder with its text gives message. A template never contains a literal brace.
template.title: Template

MomentumSelection.description:
Immutable snapshot of the effective Momentum configuration.

The canonical analysis/method identifiers are fixed to the contract matrix values
(``momentum`` / ``sma_crossover``) and cannot be overridden or made to disagree
with one another. Window and RSI values are materialized from explicit inputs or
the current configured policy at creation time; later settings changes do not
affect an existing selection. ``as_of`` and ``use_cache`` are persisted with the
selection, so a saved or refreshed run reuses the boundary and cache choice it was
created with.

as_of.description: Run the analysis as of this date (the end of that day, UTC) or this moment, which needs a timezone offset; leave empty for the latest data.
as_of.title: As of

long_window.description: Number of trading days in the long moving average; it must be larger than the short one.
long_window.title: Long window

rsi_period.description: Number of trading days the relative strength index looks back over.
rsi_period.title: RSI period

short_window.description: Number of trading days in the short moving average.
short_window.title: Short window

use_cache.description: Whether the analysis may read and write the local cache of fetched data.
use_cache.title: Use cached data

These are ``watchlist show`` and ``create``; the API serves it for a watchlist and for a created watchlist, and the
result documents below nest it, the one of an add included.
